Active Directory.description:
The Privileged Action Gateway retrieves organizational units from Active Directory.
The directory location to search in and the depth of the search can be controlled using the Search Base DN and Search Scope inputs.

Active Directory 1.description: The Privileged Action Gateway creates the new group using the details provided in the New Group Details interactive form.

Active Directory 3.description: The Privileged Action Gateway searches for groups in Active Directory with the same name as the one provided in the interactive form.

Active Directory 4.description:
The Privileged Action Gateway searches for the provided manager in Active Directory.

The manager is provided as an Identity Security Cloud identity, but the workflow needs the Active Directory account belonging to that identity to set them as the group's manager.

Active Directory 5.description: The Privileged Action Gateway sets the group's manager in Active Directory.

Compare Numbers.description: The search results are evaluated to determine if any organizational units were found in Active Directory. If one or more organizational units are found, it evaluates to True, otherwise False.

Compare Numbers 1.description: The provided group name is evaluated to determine if the name is available. If the group name is available, it evaluates to True, otherwise False.

End Step - Failure.description: The workflow cannot continue as the group was not created. The workflow ends in a failed state.

End Step - Failure 1.description: The workflow could not continue as the provided manager does not have an account in Active Directory. The workflow ends in a failed state.

End Step - Failure 2.description: The workflow cannot continue as a command error occurred while searching for groups. The workflow ends in a failed state.

End Step - Failure 3.description:
The workflow cannot continue as a group already exists with the provided name. The workflow ends in a failed state.

The user will need to launch the workflow again and provide a different name.

End Step - Failure 4.description: The workflow cannot continue as setting the group's manager failed. The workflow ends in a failed state.

End Step - Failure 5.description: The workflow cannot continue as no organizational units were found in Active Directory. The workflow ends in a failed state.

End Step - Failure 6.description: The workflow cannot continue as a command error occurred and no organizational units were found in Active Directory. The workflow ends in a failed state.

End Step - Success.description: The new group has been created and the manager has been set and notified. The workflow completed successfully.

Get Identity.description: The full identity of the manager provided in the New Group Details interactive form is retrieved.

Interactive Form.description:
This interactive form allows the user to provide details about the new group.

The user will need to enter a name, group type, manager, and location.
